title: Steam page online since 2 weeks, first Trailer, Offline Demo Slice finished,
author: PossibleJealous1979
selftext:
**Hi there fellow aigamedevs,**

I want to share my Steam page for my game I ve been working on for the last 12 months.  
Game: **Ludus Magna**  
**Genre:** Gladiator-Management, Auto-battler, QTE-Combat, Simulation, Rome  
**Status:** Web-Beta with 1600+ registered members since the very beginning, Offline Demo-Slice finished, Trailer online, storepage online since 2 weeks, DEMO-Page online, waiting for Steam to verify my DEMO since 10 days.  
**Festival:** Successfully registered for the Autobattler Festival from Nov. 16 - Nov. 23

Currently holding at 83 wishlists. I ve done no marketing since the Store page went live.  
Recently I have added a 45sec Trailer.  
Pre-recorded developer gameplay is shown 24/7 on the store page using robostreamer.  
Here is the store-page:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5386380/Ludus\_Magna/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5386380/Ludus_Magna/)

I am getting between 5-12 wishlists per day. I am using organic traffic from people looking for "gladiator browsergame" (rank 1 on google) and transferring them into wishists or web-beta-players via the website [www.ludus-magna.com](http://www.ludus-magna.com) 

Currently i am eagerly waiting for steam to give their GO for my 30-days offline demo for the game to start marketing.

I am also getting requests from random guys who want to help me do the marketing for my indie-game and get more visibility. - **Whats your experience on this? Any tips?**

**Trailer:** Super-happy with the beginning (it rocks I think), but struggling with the presentation of the game afterwards as I still need to find out how to present mostly static "management" screens visually appealing in moving pictures. Any tips or best-practice examples how other management game do it? - Did everything by hand using Capcut (Pro).

**Next steps:**  
\- contacting Streamers to play the Steam Demo or Web-Beta (with the possibility to get their own, unique, personal gladiator card based on a picture of them to play on the stream)  
\- releasing tiktok and youtube shorts  
\- doing lets plays myself and uploading to youtube  
\- publishing a demo-release news article on [gamerspress.com](http://gamerspress.com)

  
Wish me luck! I am super exicted and curious how the game will perform on steam.  


Cesare  
*Solo-Dev*
